# Historical backup fixtures

These six backups contain authored data, not learner histories. They were serialized and validated using `backupSchema` from each frozen source snapshot before being imported by the combined application. `manifest.json` records the source schema and fixture hashes.

The fixture names correspond to the owners in the [integration record](../../../integration/README.md). They include an incorrect first screen answer and the feature-specific lesson checkpoint: teaching goal/reflection, homework, live task or Ear Lab source. The studio fixture also carries its practice set. The compatibility suite verifies the retained evidence, repeat serialization and safe handling of homework created before the later variant identity existed.
